messages:
alex: Noticed lots of 413s from mixed-dim embedding batches and clients retrying blindly. Thinking we should surface a compact preflight hint so SDKs can split intelligently instead of hammering.

dina: Two-tier approach: cheap header hint for quick cases, full /v1/embeddings/preflight for heavy analysis. Header = low CPU, preflight = detailed plan + cost estimate.

jordan: Header idea: `X-Embed-Preflight: sampled=true;v=1;data=<base64>` where data decodes to `{"advice":[{"chunks":3,"dims":512},{"chunks":5,"dims":1024}],"est_units":220}`. Also `X-Embed-Plan-Id: ep-<uuid>` to join traces.

priya: SDKs should expose opt-in helper `splitAndRetry(preflight=true)` default off. Must preserve original ordering via `original_index` or ids.

sre-bot: Observability: emit span tag `embed.preflight=hint|full`, metrics `embed.preflight_hints_total`, `embed.preflight_full_total`, and `embed.auto_retry_success_total`. Gate preflight behind auth+rate-limit to avoid probing.

dina: Rollout: 2% tenants canary (sampled preflight), measure CPU and `auto_retry_success_total`. If good, expand to 20% then GA.

alex: Action items: runtime header + plan_id (alex/dina), preflight endpoint behind flag (dina/jordan), SDK helper + docs (priya), console: preflight metrics panel (observability team). I'll write a short design doc with example wire formats.
